title: Oak Leaved Creeping Fig - 2x 5cm Cuttings - Great for terrariums
description:
Transform your terrarium or garden with this charming miniature climbing fig!


KEY FEATURES
• Miniature oak-leaf shaped foliage, perfect for intricate designs.
• Versatile use in terrariums, fairy gardens, topiaries, or as a climber/groundcover.
• Slow-growing vine with a charming, spreading habit.
• Deer resistant and drought tolerant once established.
• Thrives in high humidity, making it an ideal terrarium plant.


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Ficus pumila 'Quercifolia'
Colour: Green
Season: All Seasons (Evergreen foliage)
Growth Habit: Slow, spreading, vining, climbing


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Sun to Part Shade
Soil: Well-drained soil
Watering: Medium; keep soil lightly moist, especially in high humidity environments.
Spacing: Variable depending on use (e.g., groundcover, climbing)
Height: Under 1 foot (climbing/spreading)
Spread: 2-3 feet (as groundcover)
Hardiness: USDA Zones 7-11


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Upon arrival, unpack your plants carefully and water them immediately.
• Plant in well-draining soil and ensure consistent moisture, avoiding waterlogging.
• Provide bright, indirect sunlight for optimal growth.
• Ideal for high humidity environments; consider misting regularly if growing indoors in dry conditions.
• Can be pruned to maintain desired shape and size, especially when used in topiaries or terrariums.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x 5cm Cuttings (Ficus pumila 'Quercifolia')


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
